name: Projected Tetrahedra (PT) with Barycentric Formulation
definition: A volume rendering method for unstructured tetrahedral grids that computes line integrals of higher-order attenuation functions (Bernstein polynomials in barycentric coordinates) without preintegration or depth sorting, using a novel tessellation algorithm based on barycentric properties.
summary: Projected Tetrahedra with Barycentric Formulation is a GPU-based volume rendering method for unstructured grids that ensures geometrically correct perspective interpolation using barycentric coordinates and closed-form integrals.
